authorization_basis.description: The operator identified Feature 020 lifecycle transitions as a workflow defect and requested defining their phase ownership, evidence, and operator-input boundaries. The current selected Implement task T050 authorizes aligning only Feature 020 roadmap Outcome, Scope (in), and Notes with that approved feature scope while preserving planned status.

extension_owner.route: registered FlowKit-Roadmap extension Write command; no native agent substitution or new workflow was used

version_policy.rationale: Prior roadmap amendments use a minor bump when adding material scope to a planned feature; this change adds lifecycle outcomes and delivery scope without changing identifiers or lifecycle status.

runtime_policy_decision.governance_conflict: none identified in the current constitution; the proposed policy preserves explicit roadmap verification, human-directed workflow invocation, component ownership, and the prohibition on implicit acceptance or Git integration

decision_packet.policy: Specify owns planned→specced after current authoring, required quality/clarification, independent review, current roadmap brief, valid linkage/prerequisites, and no unsettled consequential decision. Implement owns specced→in-progress after current reviewed artifacts, verified dependencies, readiness and eligible authorized scope, before coding. Close Out owns in-progress→implemented after attributable full-scope completion/convergence, independent review, required validation, and no buildable unresolved defect, before the existing explicit verified gate. Equal/advanced consistent state is retained without duplicate event; later labels alone are not evidence. Bounded recovery records only individually substantiated adjacent transitions at actual occurrence time; contradictory/deferred/abandoned states or missing routes stop. Material ambiguity or authority conflict requires focused operator resolution. No milestone implies verified, Git integration, publication, or acceptance.
decision_packet.owner_command_reconciliation: Current registered flow-roadmap 0.2.1 exposes speckit.flow-roadmap.write and load-config/review-contract scripts but has no phase_lifecycle.py, phase milestone mode, or lifecycle event writer. Proposed future owner interface in the contract is a read-only evaluate plus an owner-only apply helper and an additive PHASE_MILESTONE_REQUEST mode; it must be delivered and versioned by the extension owner before runtime use. Ordinary Write remains unchanged.
decision_packet.required_decision: Approve this exact prospective runtime/recovery policy for implementation planning and owner delivery, amend it with exact requested changes, or defer/reject runtime lifecycle effects.

decision.scope: Prospective lifecycle runtime and bounded recovery policy for delivery and use only after compatible owner implementation.
limits: No runtime lifecycle effect before compatible extension owner delivery

runtime_policy_decision.safe_handoff: T052 remains a separate owner-delivery prerequisite. Current installed flow-roadmap 0.2.1 does not provide phase lifecycle evaluation/apply support; implementation waits for that compatible reviewed owner component.
